name: Alternative user email addresses
description: Store alternative email addresses for users, in addition to the primary mail field.
project_description:
This module stores alternative email addresses for users, in addition to the single primary email address stored in the user's mail field.

This can be useful for preventing duplicate users being created for people who have multiple email addresses, as most of us do.

What it does: an unlimited-cardinality base field 'alternative_user_emails' is added to the user entity type; when the primary email is changed, the old email is automatically moved into the alternatives; user entity queries are altered so that any condition on the mail field also matches the alternatives; and validation ensures that every primary and alternative email is unique across all users. No configuration is needed or available.

Initial development sponsored by Awakened Heart Sangha. Maintained by Jonathan Shaw (jonathanshaw) and Patrick Kenny (ptmkenny).
